recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Future corrections to TestScript.common or action.common should be made in HL7/fhir-testing-ig rather than by restoring removed TestScript source in core.
issue_request: Applied/Persuasive with Modification request to support reusable TestScript actions through a common action collection with named parameters and references from setup/test actions, later refined to include action.common.keyRef, action.common.parameter, and teardown action.common behavior.
initial_application: Core PR HL7/fhir#3084 merged on 2024-05-30. Commit d9855015e35a557a252ca9a1f3bb62ab6c50a3f6 added TestScript.common, setup/test/teardown action.common references, parameters, the readcommon example, and an OID entry under source/testscript.
additional_context: Commit f9a44787c45071394532c7c2ee94d76f30f47387 later removed TestScript, TestReport, and TestPlan from core, deleted source/testscript, and added the Testing FHIR IG as the current home for testing resources. Current source/fhir.ini has no active testscript resource entry, and the Testing IG source/CI profile contains the FHIR-9197 common/action.common elements.
reconciliation: Published an empty external-repo audit commit on the combined branch because there is no current core TestScript source to edit and the authoritative external Testing IG already carries the applied action-reuse structure.

related_jiras.note: PR 3084 also included an independent TestScript.metadata.capability comment update; it was not needed to decide FHIR-9197.
A later TestScript constraint reorganization touched the same resource family before testing resources moved out of core, but it did not alter the FHIR-9197 action-reuse conclusion.

evidence_items.summary: Applied/Persuasive with Modification request to support reusable TestScript actions through common action collections and parameters.
evidence_items.learned: This is the final WG request and defines the action-reuse structure that had to be present somewhere authoritative.

evidence_items.summary: Core commit added TestScript.common, action.common references, parameters, the readcommon example, and the OID entry for FHIR-9197.
evidence_items.learned: FHIR-9197 was materially applied in core before TestScript was externalized.

evidence_items.learned: TestScript is outside the current core build scope, so a core source edit would be misplaced.

evidence_items.summary: Core commit removed TestScript, TestReport, and TestPlan source files and fhir.ini resource entries.
evidence_items.learned: The authoritative TestScript resource source was intentionally removed from core after FHIR-9197 was applied.

evidence_items.learned: The FHIR-9197 action-reuse structure is present in the external artifact that now owns TestScript.
